description: Compute monthly revenue and fiscal-year-to-date (FYTD) cumulative revenue per business unit. The fiscal year starts on February 1 and is labeled by the calendar year in which it starts (FY2025 = 2025-02-01 through 2026-01-31; January 2025 belongs to FY2024). Output one row per business unit per calendar month between the unit's first and last revenue month, including months with no revenue (monthly_revenue = 0, FYTD carried forward). FYTD resets at the start of each fiscal year. Output columns: business_unit (STRING), month (DATE), fiscal_year (INT64), monthly_revenue (FLOAT64), fytd_revenue (FLOAT64). Sort by business_unit, month.

amount.description: Revenue booked that day; days without revenue have no row

edge_cases: January belongs to the previous fiscal year; the cumulative sum resets in February, not January
Revenue on 2025-01-31 vs 2025-02-01 falls into different fiscal years
April has no revenue rows but must appear with 0 and the carried FYTD
common_failure_modes: FM2: Partitioning the running sum by EXTRACT(YEAR) resets in January instead of February
FM2: Off-by-one fiscal-year formula (e.g. year + 1 for months >= 2) mislabels every row
FM3: Running sum over daily rows without first aggregating to months yields multiple rows per month
